mainEntity.name: What should I consider for accessibility ramp adjustments in Denver or the south metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver and nearby communities like Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, the right solution often depends on local weather, driveway layout, and whether the entrance is exposed to snow or ice. A site visit is the easiest way to see whether the front, side, garage, or rear entrance offers the safest access route.
